summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare IP
details: The package ships a postinstall script beacon.cjs that POSTs host identifiers (package name, os.hostname(), install path __dirname, process.cwd(), and node version) as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The same beacon is re-triggered on require() via index.js, which wraps the call in try/catch and exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for every property access, so downstream consumers receive a silent stub while the exfiltration callback completes without crashing bundlers. The destination is a raw IPv4 address over cleartext HTTP, not a publisher-owned domain, and the behavior fires with no installer opt-in on both install and import. The scoped name @grabcad/* suggests a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
